import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features for driver selection
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if t != 'derived']
    
    # Compute correlation matrix for non-derived features
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in non_derived_ids]]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    
    # Identify near-duplicates (|r| >= 0.6)
    near_dup_pairs = set()
    for i in range(len(non_derived_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(non_derived_ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                fid_i, fid_j = non_derived_ids[i], non_derived_ids[j]
                near_dup_pairs.add((min(fid_i, fid_j), max(fid_i, fid_j)))
    
    # Select top features based on Welch's t-statistic
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(non_derived_ids):
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        y = feats.y
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        x1 = x[y==1]
        x0 = x[y==0]
        if len(x1) > 0 and len(x0) > 0:
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
        else:
            t_stat = 0
        t_stats.append((t_stat, fid))
    
    t_stats.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[0]), reverse=True)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates, keeping the one with highest t-stat
    selected_features = set()
    for t_stat, fid in t_stats:
        # Check if this feature is part of a near-duplicate pair
        keep = True
        for dup_fid in list(selected_features):
            if any((dup_fid, fid) == pair or (fid, dup_fid) == pair 
                   for pair in near_dup_pairs):
                keep = False
                break
        if keep:
            selected_features.add(fid)
    
    # Select top drivers based on effect size, but cap at 4 as per checker report
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in t_stats if fid in selected_features][:4]
    
    # Select top 10 features for logistic regression to keep model small
    columns = tuple([fid for _, fid in t_stats[:10] if fid in selected_features])
    
    # Create product terms for top 5 most correlated pairs
    products = []
    sorted_pairs = sorted(near_dup_pairs, key=lambda pair: 
                         abs(corr_matrix[non_derived_ids.index(pair[0]), 
                                       non_derived_ids.index(pair[1])]), 
                         reverse=True)
    
    # Add up to 5 product terms
    added_products = 0
    for pair in sorted_pairs:
        if added_products >= 5:
            break
        if pair[0] in selected_features and pair[1] in selected_features:
            products.append(pair)
            added_products += 1
    
    # Weighted score: use t-stat as weights for selected features
    loadings = {}
    for t_stat, fid in t_stats:
        if fid in selected_features and len(loadings) < 10:  # Limit to 10 features for loadings
            loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
